item.title: Channing Lane leads Blue Mountain women in steals and assists through a 7–1 start
item.description: Through eight games before Thanksgiving, Channing Lane leads the Blue Mountain Christian University women in two categories: 23 steals and 26 assists. She has scored 79 points, tied with Isabella Aversa for third on the team. The Toppers from Tippah County enter their break at 7–1 overall, 1–1 in Southern States Athletic Conference play. The university’s cumulative statistics credit Blue Mountain with 99 steals, an average of 12.4 per game, against 65 for its opponents. Its opponents have committed 167 turnovers to Blue Mountain’s 127. Blue Mountain has averaged 19.6 points off turnovers per game and allowed 11.0. Steals and total turnovers are separate statistics. Blue Mountain recorded double-digit steals in seven of its eight games. Its season high of 16 came in its only loss, 76–60 at Faulkner on Nov. 14. A week later, in its first conference win, the Toppers recorded 14 steals as Wesleyan committed 31 turnovers. Blue Mountain committed 12 turnovers of its own in the 91–52 win in Macon, Georgia. Lena Taylor is second on the team with 16 steals and leads the scoring with 125 points. Brooklyn Hodum has 13 steals and Isabella Aversa has 11. Lane averages 2.9 steals and 3.3 assists per game. Lane’s 23 steals and Taylor’s 16 account for 39 of the team’s 99. The Toppers resume play at home on December 3 against Point University. Season and game-by-game records: https://bmcusports.com/sports/womens-basketball/stats/2026-27 . Wesleyan box score: https://bmcusports.com/sports/womens-basketball/stats/2026-27/wesleyan-college/boxscore/5885 . Faulkner box score: https://bmcusports.com/sports/womens-basketball/stats/2026-27/faulkner-university-ala-/boxscore/5883 .

item.title: Walnut hosts Alcorn Central while Pine Grove opens region play against Thrasher
item.description: Two Tippah County gyms will host varsity basketball doubleheaders on Tuesday, December 1. At Walnut, the girls face Alcorn Central at 6 p.m. and the boys play at 7:30. At Pine Grove, the girls host Thrasher at 6 and the boys schedule lists a 7 p.m. start. Pine Grove’s team schedules mark both Thrasher games as region contests. The games at Walnut are listed without the region designation. Walnut’s boys enter the break with three straight wins. They beat Strayhorn 64–49, Belmont 53–50 and Jumpertown 64–51. The Alcorn Central boys beat South Pontotoc and Itawamba Agricultural on consecutive days, both by seven. Their schedule also includes Holly Springs on November 27 before the trip to Walnut. The Walnut girls go into the holiday off a 61–26 win over Lafayette after falling to Wheeler 64–54. Pine Grove’s most recent posted varsity games were at Ingomar on November 20. The boys won 60–36, while the girls lost 75–44. The Panthers’ available boys results include wins over Houlka in overtime, East Union, Ashland and Blue Mountain. After Tuesday’s home region games, both Pine Grove teams go to Wheeler for region games Friday, December 4; Walnut’s teams travel to Bruce that day. Sources: https://www.maxpreps.com/ms/walnut/walnut-wildcats/basketball/schedule/ (Walnut boys); https://www.maxpreps.com/ms/walnut/walnut-wildcats/basketball/girls/schedule/ (Walnut girls); https://www.maxpreps.com/ms/ripley/pine-grove-panthers/basketball/schedule/ (Pine Grove boys); https://www.maxpreps.com/ms/ripley/pine-grove-panthers/basketball/girls/schedule/ (Pine Grove girls); https://www.maxpreps.com/ms/glen/alcorn-central-bears/basketball/schedule/ (Alcorn Central boys).

item.title: Blue Mountain opens December with four conference doubleheaders at home
item.description: Blue Mountain Christian University will open December with four consecutive SSAC home dates for both basketball teams. Its separate men’s and women’s schedules agree on the opponents, days and sites. Point University comes to Blue Mountain Thursday, December 3, with the women at 5:30 p.m. and the men at 7:30 p.m. Life University visits Saturday, December 5, with the women at noon and men at 2 p.m. The following week brings the University of Mobile on Thursday, December 10 at 5:30 and 7:30 p.m., and William Carey on Saturday, December 12 at noon and 2 p.m. The earlier game on each date is the women’s game. These are the first home conference games for both squads this season. The men ended November 3–3 overall, 3–0 at home and 0–2 in league play. Their two road conference losses came by four at Faulkner and by two at Dalton State. The wins at home came against Rust, Stillman and Bethel. The women return after winning 91–52 at Wesleyan on November 21. They split their first two SSAC games, losing 76–60 at Faulkner before beating Wesleyan. The schedules diverge after the four paired dates: the men travel to Bethel December 15. Both teams host Tennessee Southern Thursday, December 17, with the women at 5 and men at 7 p.m. Sources: https://bmcusports.com/sports/mens-basketball/schedule and https://bmcusports.com/sports/womens-basketball/schedule . All times are local to the Blue Mountain home games.
